title: RECURSIVE_CJT_STATE_SCHEMA_v0_2
description: RC-0.1 schema. Supersedes v0_1 (preserved). Adds the typed CJT transformation interface (Cause/EffectCandidate/CJTStepResult), the versioned-intent envelope, the effect-publication authority, latent-vs-enforced readiness, and the kernel-level branch ceilings. Everything in v0_1 not overridden here carries forward, including the measurement_contract, the route equation, and the compute unit. Reference implementation: sim/rc01_types.py, sim/rc01_engine.py, sim/rc01_coordinator.py.
carries_forward_from_v0_1: bias_state (S, M, P_RPM, Z, Theta, G)

cause.description: The routed object. GOLD WALL: no field for required_op / expected outcome exists; construction rejects gold-shaped evidence markers. The verifier's gold table is sealed and inaccessible to routing code.

effect_candidate.description: Typed Effect produced by CJTStep. NOT published until the latch authorizes it.

cjt_step_result.description: (E_t, B-hat_{t+1}) = CJTStep(C_t, B_t): the Effect plus PROPOSED updates; nothing becomes B_{t+1} until the coordinator commits.

verifier_receipt_digest.description: Required for publication-consequence intents; must match a receipt the coordinator has sealed.

versioned_intent.atomicity: one invalid intent rejects the whole batch; rejections are sealed in the trace naming the FIRST failed law; state remains byte-identical

publication_law.note: A refused Effect may update diagnostic state; it never receives publication authority. Consequences run ONLY after the diagnostic commit succeeds (the delayed wire).

readiness.latent_readiness: truth, computed from D/W/P against frozen thresholds; ALWAYS computed
readiness.rpm_enforcement_enabled: whether the gate blocks; ablation removes enforcement only
readiness.forced_publication: published while a required prerequisite was false
readiness.desire_law: a Desire block DEPRIORITIZES (DESIRE_DEPRIORITIZED); the kernel never repairs Desire to invent relevance

recursion_gates.max_active_branches: kernel-level concurrent subgoal ceiling (ACTIVE_BRANCH_LIMIT), in addition to per-expert governance max_branches
recursion_gates.acquisition_cache: one-directional (Correction 2); CACHE_HIT prevents duplicate repair; an explicit invalidation event (INVALIDATION_REOPEN) reopens

quarantine.registry: kernel-owned (Governance stays owner-only); sealed QUARANTINE / REOPEN transitions
quarantine.reopen: only by an owner-authorized reopen event
quarantine.routing: quarantined experts score exactly 0; a quarantined-only route skips the cause (ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE_QUARANTINED) so a later reopen can restore it
